janganDiulang.judul: Substring keyword match (kw in text) over short tokens = latent bug
janganDiulang.isi: (ide⊂presiden, sintesis⊂fotosintesis, api⊂rapikan). Whole-word for single tokens. (EXP-074/F-053/F-072)

janganDiulang.judul: RRF _retrieval_score for relevance gating = unreliable
janganDiulang.isi: in small collections (rank-based, top ~0.83 even if irrelevant). Use dense cosine. (EXP-076)

janganDiulang.judul: Margin 6 for jina drops nothing
janganDiulang.isi: (its range is compressed ±4) — margin is model-specific. (EXP-081c)

janganDiulang.judul: MiniLM-L-6 (English) for ID semantic rerank = insufficient
janganDiulang.isi: (10/12, demotes relevant below junk). Use a MULTILINGUAL reranker for Indonesian. (EXP-081a)

janganDiulang.judul: Absolute drop-cutoff for episodic rerank = MOAT-UNSAFE.
janganDiulang.isi: Relevant Indonesian taught-facts score NEGATIVE on indirect queries (MiniLM −6.4, jina −1.9). Use relative-margin + always-keep-top. (EXP-081b)

janganDiulang.judul: A builder's own self-report is not validation
janganDiulang.isi: build_cycle12 said "leak=0" while an INDEPENDENT audit found inherited leak+volatile. Always validate with a separate script. (EXP-086c)

janganDiulang.judul: Greedy volatile regex (officeholder .{0,40} (saat ini|sekarang|adalah)) = false positives
janganDiulang.isi: it dropped GOOD abstain examples ("belum punya info terkini tentang wali kota …") + unrelated reasoning. Require an asserted Capitalized NAME AND exclude abstain-markers. (EXP-086b)

janganDiulang.judul: NEVER SFT a volatile officeholder fact even when CORRECT
janganDiulang.isi: (e.g. "...adalah Prabowo Subianto") — goes stale next election + teaches assert-without-RAG; national_kb serves it. SFT stable behaviors only. (EXP-086b/F-088)

janganDiulang.judul: Cumulative Growth-Ring prior carries contamination forever
janganDiulang.isi: a builder that filters only the NEW increment is insufficient; a holdout near-dup + a stale-wrong "Presiden adalah Joko Widodo" sat in prior and would re-train every cycle. Apply all quality guards to the PRIOR too; re-scan prior whenever a held-out probe is a

janganDiulang.judul: on-instance merged_16bit tar/GGUF-export is unreliable
janganDiulang.isi: (failed twice: GGUF export AND a 22MB weightless tar). For own-model trains, download the LoRA adapter (small, reliable) + merge on the VPS (CPU venv: transformers≥5 + peft matching the adapter version). That path recovered cycle-12. (F-091/092)

janganDiulang.judul: NEVER SFT an own-model on its OWN (or a weaker sibling's) generated outputs as chosen targets
janganDiulang.isi: self-distillation collapse. cycle-12 (EXP-087) trained on 22/58 organic pairs whose chosen came from local:migancore:0.3 (the weaker prod model) → 0.5 REGRESSED vs 0.4 (halu .94→.84, tool .92→.79, reason 1.0→.75), gate ROLLBACK. Use ONLY a STRONGER teacher's c

janganDiulang.judul: Don't load qwen3:30b-a3b under prod load on the 31GB box
janganDiulang.isi: OOM-kills llama-server (EXP-088); use qwen3:14b as escalation target until RAM upgrade.

janganDiulang.judul: Small models (≤4B) can't do cortex state-extraction reliably
janganDiulang.isi: qwen2.5:0.5b hallucinates an agent-trace / echoes the field descriptions / captures the surface layer; 4B already failed (F-145). JSON-schema constraint fixes FORMAT (kills the hallucinated trace) but NOT content quality. The open_question field is load-bearin
